public_api: WorldSamplerMRV legacy name retained for caller compatibility

production_contract.counting: int64 suffix dynamic program over tile position and three remaining capacities; 8^3 capacity states per position
production_contract.sampling: assign each tile to a seat in proportion to the exact suffix completion count behind that branch
production_contract.result: uniform over complete assignments because branch probabilities telescope to 1/root_completion_count
production_contract.random_draw: exact 62-bit integer randbelow with two bounded candidates; no float32 random-key ordering
production_contract.padding: padded pool positions are identity transitions
production_contract.device: all counting and sampling remain on the requested torch device; no CUDA-to-CPU fallback
production_contract.failure: infeasible inputs fail from root_completion_count=0; internal dead ends or exhausted integer draws raise before returning a partial world

rejected_intermediate.what_worked: uniform random partitions conditioned on void validity fixed malformed output and matched exact-uniform frequencies on the three original late-state fixtures
rejected_intermediate.verdict: mathematically uniform when it returns, but unusable because real valid mass can be below 0.01 percent; increasing the budget was rejected as the repair

tests.cuda_tests: retained but skipped on this Mac

cpu_microbench.method: median of five fixed-seed Python timing runs; per-run loops 25 for 32x50 and 100 for single-game cases; no CUDA synchronization or production-device claim

low_mass_judsearch_1_game_x_10_samples.rejected_uniform_rejection_result: failed after 40960 proposals with 3 of 10 worlds

performance_interpretation: completion DP is slower than the rejected rejection sampler on easy CPU states but faster by an unbounded factor on low-valid-mass states because its work does not depend on acceptance probability
platform_boundary: CUDA was unavailable on this Mac; CUDA tests are retained but skipped, so production-device throughput and memory remain to be measured
